sources.title: LAB 8: Challenge of Discrepancy
sources.quote: The initial helper starts by using exploration skills to help the client explore.
sources.technique: First use reflections, restatements, and open questions to explore the concern and establish support; only then gently name a discrepancy you have noticed and invite the client to respond.

sources.title: Challenging Skills
sources.quote: Process comments are one form of immediacy that involve the counselor cueing the client to focus on the interpersonal process in the session rather than the session content.
sources.technique: When it may help deepen awareness, gently comment on an observable shift in the here-and-now interaction and ask what the client noticed or felt, rather than repeating a reflection of their story.
